chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Ch. 69 — A Daughter’s Reckoning Over Rice and Tears
chapter_meta_description: Chun Xiaoman returns from killing the father who sold her. Li Huowang offers only a bowl of rice. A quiet, brutal chapter on the cost of justice.
og_description: Xiaoman eats with tears soaking her rice. Li Huowang watches and says nothing holy.
twitter_title: Dao-Twisted World 69: The meal after murder
twitter_description: Xiaoman goes home for vengeance. There’s no celebration—just a bowl of rice and a woman who has seen enough.
